## Description and Rationale

We are a passionate team from the Marmara University Data Science Club, deeply dedicated to the aviation domain. Having previously worked with OpenSky Network trajectory data, we have hands-on experience handling ADS-B datasets and analyzing flight operations.

We want to apply our data science background to real-world air traffic management challenges. Participating in the PRC Data Challenge allows us to bridge theory with practice, benchmark our models on high-impact operational problems, and contribute to open aviation research.

Linkedin Account: https://www.linkedin.com/company/datascienceclub-marmara/

## Details

* Type: Academia
* Country: Turkey
